parts.content: Work in D:\PropelExp. Implement the backend and AI portions of attached EP-004 US-026 through US-030, including the user-approved minimum prerequisites: FastAPI scaffold and confirmed-deficiency contracts. Existing first slice: backend/src/cms_planner/domain/deficiency.py, poc.py and backend/tests/unit/domain/test_poc.py. Follow immutable Pydantic v2 domain, inward dependencies, transient in-memory storage, repository atomic update/locking, no durable storage. Required behavior: generation denied before provider call unless current deficiency revision confirmed; generation input only requested deficiency reviewed fields/evidence; concurrent/repeated same deficiency revision yields one current unapproved draft; strict exactly ordered five non-empty sections and extras rejected; typed validation failures; grounding retains only valid same-deficiency field/evidence refs, replaces unsupported facility claims with typed markers, preserves generic guidance; marker replacement appends user-edited revision/history/readiness and removal restores marker; editing appends unapproved revision with changed section origins; stale conflict and failures preserve retained current revision. Add provider-neutral contracts and deterministic guardrails under backend/src/cms_planner/adapters/ai, application services/ports, API route/composition root, prompts/poc/*.md, and focused unit/integration tests. Update backend/pyproject.toml minimally with FastAPI/Uvicorn/httpx if required and useful lint/type scripts only if project convention supports. IMPORTANT: inspect existing code/tests first, preserve unrelated changes, do not edit task markdown yet, do not commit. Use apply_patch for edits. Run focused tests immediately after first edit and then full backend pytest. Return concise changed files and validation results, plus blockers.
